question: In 1932, who discovered the positron, a particle described as ‘carrying a positive charge but having a mass of the same order of magnitude as that normally possessed by a free negative electron’?
solution:
The correct answer is__** Carl Anderson**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In 1932, American physicist** ****Carl David Anderson** made a groundbreaking discovery

 
 
• ​He detected a positively charged particle with a mass equivalent to that of an electron. 
 
 
 
• This particle, known as the positron, was the first antiparticle proven experimentally.
